stem: The main cable of a small suspension footbridge hangs between two towers. The height of the cable above the deck of the bridge, in meters, is modeled by \(h(x) = 0.01x^{2} - 0.8x + 20\), where \(x\) is the horizontal distance, in meters, from one of the towers. According to the model, what is the least height, in meters, of the cable above the deck?
solution: The parabola opens upward, so its vertex gives the least height.
verify:
x = symbols('x')
h = Rational(1, 100)*x**2 - Rational(8, 10)*x + 20
xv = solve(diff(h, x), x)[0]
assert xv == 40 and h.subs(x, xv) == 4
assert Rational(spr_answers[0]) == h.subs(x, xv)
